name: Villarrasa (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villarrasa (a tower and a castle on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Villarrasa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villarrasa arms — tower and castle on blue
